summary: Asked to draw herself, Nora makes a new picture of herself in a setting instead of sending back her reference picture.
details: A request to picture her now gets a setting, pose or expression that fits the room or the moment. Before this, a prompt that restated her reference's pose and blank background made the image service return the reference itself, so the room just saw her canonical picture again.
A plain front view is still what she makes when someone asks for her standard look or her reference sheet.
limitations: The skill ships in the image: a rebuild is needed for it to reach production.
